newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products firm, gasoline tight.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products firm, gasoline tight.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were steady to firm on Thursday, traders said.
The gasoline market continued tight as a U.S. major confirmed it had over the past days bought at least one cargo that dealers believed may have been related to refinery problems in Italy.
Demand in the eastern Med continued firm amid little gasoline availability.
No fresh naphtha trades were seen Thursday, but the Med and NWE markets were seen by dealers stable to slightly firm.
Gas oil prices firmed 25 cents a tonne in line with IPE futures but traders differed over fair value.
Some said the Med fob high quotes +$5 rumoured paid for a cargo of EN590 gas oil on Wednesday appeared below the market. Russian heating oil remained discussed at around cif Med high +$3 basis Genoa.
Exxon's Augusta refinery in Sicily has lowered gas oil output because of a technical fault at a topping plant but the amount of the reduction was not known.

Italy's ISAB has cut crude throughput by around 10 percent or 23,000 barrels per day (bpd) at its Sicily refinery due to deteriorating margins. Throughput at the Melilli refinery may well be cut further in August. The throughput cut has been in effect for two weeks.
High sulphur fuel oil was little changed although prices were thought buoyed by currently strong trader bidding.
An Italian refiner sold a 25,000 tonne high sulphur cracked cargo on Wednesday to a trader at around $1-$1.50 over the quoted Med fob high. The cargo loads late this month.
The same refiner also sold a 50,000 tonne cargo for the first decade of August at a similar price, and is not expected to have material until the end of next month.
Low sulphur fuel oil was little changed.
